newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banamex ends 8.54 bln peso capitalization.
newsitem.headline: Banamex ends 8.54 bln peso capitalization.

text.p: Mexico's largest banking group, Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival (Banacci), said on Wednesday it had completed an 8.54 billion peso capitalization program for its banking unit, Banamex.

It said the last tranche of the program was covered with the $57.5 million payment to Banacci by First Data Corp in connection with the recent public offering of Moneygram Payment Systems Inc. Banamex is Moneygram's primary agent in Mexico.
In the aftermath of last year's peso crisis, Banacci pledged to raise 8.54 billion pesos of fresh capital in exchange for selling 15 billion pesos in loans to Fobaproa, Mexico's bank insurance fund.

The amount of annual MoneyGram transactions from the United States to Mexico has risen from 7,000 in 1990 to over 2.4 million in 1995, giving MoneyGram a 30 percent share of the volume of electronic transfer services between the two countries, a Banacci statement said.
